display.title: Episode 358: The Return of Yehudah, Chapter 3
display.summary_short: The new Shiviti Club, a listener's homemade Shiviti sign, and a stormy night of escape in The Return of Yehudah, ending with baby Yehudah left behind in the pit.
display.summary_long: Uncle Yossi celebrates the mail pouring in for the new Shiviti Club and replays the Shiviti song sung by a class of girls. In the mailbox, a boy from New Jersey describes the Shiviti sign he made and looks at every morning, even before Modeh Ani, to remember that Hashem is with him; Uncle Yossi invites everyone to send in their own sign. After the Hakochainik march, a nine-year-old guest in Studio 604 leads the Shema. Story time continues The Return of Yehudah: Reb Moshe, Sarah and little Yehudah are held in a pit by a cruel poritz for unpaid rent. In a fierce storm a kind neighbor, Beryl, pulls them out while the guard sleeps and sends them off in a wagon, but in the dark Sarah grabbed the wrong blanket, and Yehudah is still in the pit. The show ends with the next steps of the morning routine, Modeh Ani and negel vasser, and Friday's candle-lighting time.
display.lesson: Remember the moment you wake up that Hashem is right there with you, then thank Him with Modeh Ani and wash negel vasser.
